verdicts.reason: A is basically the original on a slightly wider canvas. Every element keeps its order and alignment, but nothing is actually rearranged, and the right margin under the photo is a little wider than the left. B scrambles the event list out of date order (02 Dec, 13 Jan, 20 Jan, 16 Dec, 06 Jan, 09 Dec), drops the legal line into the middle of the list, moves the 'Winter Programme' eyebrow below the schedule and shrinks the logo to a tiny mark at the bottom, so the reading order and hierarchy are broken.
